transcript.line: 🩹 Antonia is still hurting (60 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
🎙️ The Eulogy's turn

📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then they stood their ground, poor brave fools." The spotlight widens. (No weight yet — just the story starting.) (5 verses remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
ROUND 2!
The red comes down. Your next 3 strikes deal +100% damage. (Unleash Rage — hold on.)
You focus — that costs your action.
🌀 Berserker Rage is STRAINING at its edges. The gift wants to become something — and it wants YOU to choose what.
"IT’S MOLTING! We didn’t program molting! This is YOUR doing! CHOOSE! Choose what it becomes!"
(Evolution awaits — choose one. Your power becomes something new.)
"We didn't even explain that part! You figured it out yourself! That's the good stuff! The gamblers are thrilled!"
(−60 kcal — food becomes rage.)
🎙️ The Eulogy's turn

📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then they ran, and the spotlight followed." The spotlight narrows. Your dodge feels watched. (-10% dodge.) (4 verses remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
💥 eulogy's attack finds you — no dodging it.
Armor absorbs 17.
Eulogy's attack hits you for 28.
📖 Codex: Epitaph — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
ROUND 3!
The red comes down. Your next 3 strikes deal +100% damage. (Unleash Rage — hold on.)
You focus — that costs your action.
(−60 kcal — food becomes rage.)
🎙️ The Eulogy's turn

📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then they bled, politely, where everyone could see." The narration lingers on your wounds. (Bleeds last 1 round longer.) (3 verses remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
💥 It connects!
Armor absorbs 25.
Eulogy's attack hits you for 43.
📖 Codex: Final Chapter — strikes one target after a windup. You won't forget this.
ROUND 4!
🎙️ The Eulogy's turn

📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then they knelt, and the story approved." The story leans in. (The Eulogy's attacks +15.) (2 verses remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
💥 Final Chapter!
Armor absorbs 22.
Eulogy's Final Chapter hits you for 38.
You go down.
OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Afnan Bajunaid is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
🕯️ Afnan Bajunaid is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Afnan kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Afnan's gone." Kennedy looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Afnan." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Guiying blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Afnan Bajunaid, 92 days. The mantle passes to Guiying Situ.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Guiying Situ, 38 — a Vintner. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Green Whisper.
You knew Afnan — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Kennedy speaks for Guiying — "Afnan trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Guiying before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

activatables.why: No game to dress. Hunt or trap something first, then break it down clean.

strike.sigTrick: Meet one demand — buy a quiet round

reunion.sigTrick: Do something you have never done

algorithm.sigTrick: Lose on purpose — tank the prediction

rerun.sigTrick: Win fast — or write between takes

timeslot.sigTrick: Be boring enough to get bumped

finale_opening.sigTrick: Meet it while it is still arriving
